run_generate_dtd_test_data: run the dtd.py module to generate fake DTD test data with random JPEG images and labels
generate_data_split: generate fake DTD test data for a given split name and number of examples
create_output_directory: create the output directory structure for fake DTD test data under tfds_dir
run_main_cli: run the dtd.py CLI entrypoint to generate train1, val1, and test1 splits
makedir_if_not_exists: create a directory if it does not already exist using tf.io.gfile
